title: Seagrove "Seasons in the Sun" 140 Dalton Drive
h1: Seagrove "Seasons in the Sun" 140 Dalton Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day**- Walkable distance to The Greenway Station - Shopping & Dining - 6 passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Professionally decorated- Fire Pit- 2 Yolo Boards- Kayak- 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout.DETAILS: Seasons in the Sun has everything you’re looking for in a newly-built luxury beach home! This gorgeous 5-bedroom, 6-bathroom Seagrove Beach cottage sleeps 12, has a private pool, includes a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle, and is a short walk to the beach! Thoughtful design touches help make Seasons in the Sun truly special. Guests will love the comfortable open living, dining, and kitchen space on the first floor that overlooks a backyard deck and pool. Hardwood floors, white shiplap walls, luxurious finishes, and accessories inspired by the beach create a space guests will enjoy. Premium appliances, marble countertops, and an island that seats 4 create a kitchen with plenty of space to prepare meals. A butler’s pantry hides a stackable washer/dryer and provides additional counter space. A dining table seats 6 and divides the kitchen from the living area. 2 linen sofas and an oversized armchair with a footrest surround a 75” Smart TV, and enjoy views of the deck through sliding glass doors that open to the pool area. A mudroom off the living area provides access to the backyard and has hooks for towels, shelves for beach bags and toys, quick access to a bathroom with a shower, and a beverage fridge. In the heat of the summer, guests will appreciate the wood decking that surrounds the pool. An outdoor dining table, cushioned chaise lounge chairs, and a gas grill surround the pool. An outdoor shower makes it simple to rinse off beach sand before jumping in the sand.On the second floor is a common area bathroom with a shower, as well as 4 guest bedrooms with either a king or queen bed or a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds and a small balcony. Three of the bedrooms have a private bathroom with a shower. A primary bedroom on the third floor has an upholstered king bed, a private balcony, and a spacious bathroom with a gorgeous soaking tub, a spacious glass-enclosed shower, and double sinks. Explore all of Seagrove Beach on 5 included adult bikes, or make trips to the beach easy on the 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle! Seasons in the Sun is sure to delight with its beautiful interiors and lovely touches that make enjoying a beach vacation easy. Book Seasons in the Sun today!
